audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-3 disagreed across layers: phases[].side read Lissandra on all seven rows while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Skill for levels 1 through 5.
audit.why: Pre-6 Diana is a melee last-hitter with a 15s Pale Cascade shield that eats Q chip and no engage at all; the lane is genuinely even until Frozen Tomb answers Lunar Rush.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 moved to Skill as one atomic group with the two whys that claimed a Lissandra advantage rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated that Lunar Rush has no cooldown against a Moonlight-marked target, so its 22/20/18/16/14 timer looked absolute.
audit.why: Riot's E text is explicit: no cooldown when dashing to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight from Crescent Strike. Her entry timer is really the Q arc, not the E.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, enemyWin, ahead and the chase Don't now key off the mark rather than the raw dash cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text said to 'self-cast R instantly to stun her mid-leap' and called Moonfall a channel. Self-cast Frozen Tomb stuns nobody — Riot's text says it encases Lissandra, healing her while untargetable and invulnerable — and Moonfall is a pull with a delayed crash, not a channel.
audit.why: The bullet conflated the two R modes, which are opposite plays: tomb HER to stop the leap, tomb YOURSELF to survive the burst.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now says to tomb her on the spot so the Moonfall pull is never cast; the self-R play moved to its own Do bullet. Pale Cascade's shield (15s) is named as the thing that eats a burst window, per missingInteractions.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Lunar Rush 22s to 14s plus its free-on-Moonlight reset, Pale Cascade 15s, Frozen Tomb 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Diana called he/his in tldr, tradeGood, loading, phases[0].why, phases[3].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].t/.d and four report entries; dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists diana as female; the owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun is Diana.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed across the full layer and the two report entries the sweep permits; both bleed bullets rewritten to their own titles.
